'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Unknown player LS Watch Your Step (page 121)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by an unknown player (no name on the sheet) at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

The player name, deck name, date and both side boxes are blank on this sheet; the side is Light by its cards. The sheet lists 60 main-deck lines and 12 shields.

'''Transcription notes''' (left for later cleanup): Line 2 written ''Tatooine (EP1)'': Episode I Tatooine; version not confirmed; Line 16 written ''Chewbacca'': version not confirmed; Line 18 written ''X-Wing Cannon'': not confirmed; Line 19 written ''Spaceport Dock Bay'': not confirmed; Line 20 written ''Falcon'': not expanded; Line 25 written ''All Wings Combo'': not expanded; Line 26 written ''Projection'': not expanded; Line 27 written ''Wokling'' (V): not confirmed; Line 28 written ''Mos Espa DB'': not expanded; Line 31 written ''Nar Shaddaa Chimes Combo'' (V): not expanded; Line 33 written ''Bossk's Ship?''
